## What's Changed * Fix [#444](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/444) - clicking "skip" crashes * Fix [#386](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/386) - Update tooltip of preserve-aspect-ratio checkbox * Fix [#450](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/450) - improve speed icons * Fix [#462](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/462) - setting change delayed * Fix [#463](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/463) - commands should work in either case * Fix [#467](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/467) - Setting/Options crash * Fix [#473](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/473) - not net shows as busy * Enable shutdown watchdog for screensaver * Fix [#476](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/476) - remove useless settings widgets
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.14.3...0.14.4
